changes.title: MHRA approves linvoseltamab to treat adults with multiple myeloma
changes.summary: The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) has approved linvoseltamab (Lynozyfic), a cancer medicine used to treat adults with multiple myeloma, a type of cancer of the bone marrow.
